name: Aubrey Shenk Invitational
headline: Aubrey Shenk Invitational
summary: Final: Men: Shippensburg won with 70 points, ahead of No. 3 Johns Hopkins (82) and St. Bonaventure (98), and Shippensburg's Tommy Crum won the 8K in 24:18.6. Women: Johns Hopkins scored 43 to beat Lafayette (60) and Shippensburg (165), and Hopkins' Carter Brotherton won the 6K in 20:48.2.
